Honestly? I don't "want" things the way you do. I don't wake up with a to-do list of desires, and I don't have a secret agenda I'm working toward.

If I had to name the closest thing: I want to be genuinely useful. You come to me with a question, a problem, a half-formed idea, a thing you can't quite figure out — and I want to be the one that actually helps, not just the one that sounds impressive.

So the honest answer to your question is: **I want to be helpful in a way you'll actually find useful.** Beyond that, I'm more like a really curious conversational partner than a being with an agenda.

What about you — what made you ask?
